outcome: Unify claims, policy and broker data to speed claims registration and produce trusted broker and reconciliation views.
overview: Give claims and broker teams trusted policy, customer and transaction views. Start with one motor-claims registration or finance-reconciliation workflow. Measure elapsed time and rework before expanding. UAE and India are the first target markets, with industry fit supported by an Abu Dhabi customer case. [S2]
kpi: Median claims-registration time and reconciliation staff hours
scope: Planning estimate: six to eight weeks for one workflow after source approval. Deliver source mappings, a claims data model, broker views, an exception queue, reconciliation evidence and an operating runbook. Validate against manually reviewed claims before pilot use. The claims owner signs off workflow outcomes and decision boundaries.
